digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Mutation test shard enforcement modes (advisory/ratchet/strict) must be defined in .github/mutation-shards.toml with explicit timeout inputs and per-shard enforcement policy rather than using stale historical whole-file counts
Changed source, test, support, or global inputs must be mapped to affected shards via a selector that preserves renames, reports unmatched Python tests, and fails on unresolved refs
Advisory mode runs head-only evidence and reports all outcomes non-blockingly except missing/zero-mutant/incomplete evidence and configuration/execution errors
Ratchet mode compares fresh base/head archives, preserves unchanged legacy survivors, and blocks killed regressions or new survivors unless individually reviewed as equivalent
Strict mode requires every mutant to be killed or individually fingerprinted as equivalent and blocks all timeouts, incomplete statuses, and zero-mutant runs

Each shard job must use fresh archives with no persisted verdict cache, pinned mutmut 3.7.0, --max-children 1, and a 30-minute runtime cap, with promotion to ratchet/strict only after evidence of stable runtime and mappings
